messages:
sam: deploy-bot queued UNPIN of model variant llama4q-8k-fast -> llama4q-8k-opt for canary at 11:00 UTC. tagging runtime/opt/qa/sre.
deploy-bot: Scheduled action: UNPIN model llama4q-8k-fast -> llama4q-8k-opt (canary). Trigger: model-release-window. ETA: 11:00 UTC.
opt-ryan: Quick note: opt variant changes KV cache TTL and routing affinity to prefer shorter warmups. We added it to reduce token cost for short prompts.
qa-lee: FYI we saw a small uptick in rerank hallucination score in staging when using the opt variant under mixed-batch loads. Will dig in.
sam: Hold for moment. If hallucination metric increases in canary that could be a production sev for a handful of customers.
runtime-julie: Can you paste the alert? Which metric specifically?
qa-lee: Alert excerpt: `eval.rerank.hallucination_rate` jumped from 0.6% -> 1.8% in recent test runs. Repro: run reranker eval with 40% short prompts using llama4q-8k-opt.
qa-lee: Small repro command: `./harness/run_eval --model llama4q-8k-opt --profile rerank --mix short:40,long:60`
qa-lee: Diff snippet in outputs: expected top-1 accuracy 0.72 -> actual 0.61, hallucination examples attached in gist (private).
opt-ryan: Hmm — we changed the prefix cache TTL from 2s -> 0 (aggressive eviction) to favor freshness. That may cause the model to miss cached context and re-evaluate earlier tokens differently.
sre-ishaan: Impact estimate: ~0.3% of production requests use this model variant; mostly internal A/B experiments but includes one third-party reranker. Recommend PAUSE unpin until we triage.
support-ana: If we hold >25m, I'll ping the account owner for the third-party reranker.
sam: Pause unpin please. We'll escalate to opt/runtime to investigate TTL vs behavior tradeoff.
deploy-bot: Actionable: PAUSE unpin action for thread 3654321001. Reason: rerank hallucination signal on llama4q-8k-opt. (requested by sam)
opt-ryan: Quick triage findings: cache TTL change plus a small beam config change (beam=2->3) combined to increase diversity; more beam diversity + no prefix cache makes the model pick alternative high-scoring but hallucinated tokens. Locally reverting TTL to 2s or restoring beam=2 both reduce hallucination.
runtime-julie: We can push a runtime config override for this variant to keep TTL=2s while keeping other optimizations. That would be a safe scoped fix.
qa-lee: Can you add a smoke that runs rerank eval across mix with the override? I can run it in CI and in the canary harness.
opt-ryan: Opening hotfix PR with variant config override: https://git.internal/redwood/opt/pull/450 "chore: restore prefix_ttl for llama4q-8k-opt for rerank safety"
sam: ETA for PR CI?
qa-lee: CI queued, ETA ~28m. I'll prep scoped canary to 5% rerank cohort once artifact ready.
sre-ishaan: I'll add temporary monitor: eval.rerank.hallucination_rate > 1.0% => notify #incidents.
product-maya: If this holds we should mention it briefly in release notes as "behavioral guard for rerank workloads" so customers know we tuned variant defaults.
support-ana: I'll draft a short KB entry for the third-party account to explain the hold if we need it.
opt-ryan: CI passed (3654322500). Artifact: model-llama4q-8k-opt:canary-override-450.
qa-lee: Starting scoped canary at 11:45 UTC to 5% rerank cohort (rerank-only routing).
sam: Monitoring initial 15m: hallucination_rate back to baseline in cohort; rerank accuracy restored. No latency regression.
product-maya: good to update release notes and changelog; call out the override and planned follow-up to evaluate TTL trade-offs for general traffic.
sre-ishaan: Ill keep the alert on for 2 hours. If stable, resume unpin.
sam: Decision: resume unpin but only after 30m stable window; follow up with opt/runtime on a long-term plan to avoid surprise behavioral changes when changing cache semantics.
deploy-bot: Resuming UNPIN: proceeding with staged canary -> remaining canary -> regional rollouts once stability window satisfied.
sam: Notifying support leads and closing thread after full roll completes. Thanks team for the quick triage :thumbsup:
